Vector Lock Quirk.name: Vector Lock Quirk
Vector Lock Quirk.description:
🛑 You lock the motion of moving things in place for a moment, then let them go or turn them onto a new line.

🌱 Touch a punch, a swung bat or a thrown object and it stops dead, then goes on its way or turns onto a new line at the same speed.
📈 Training adds locking a runner at a glance, midair pivots, easing falls and crashes to a gentle stop, turning gunfire into the floor and rerouting a whole city block.
⚠️ You never add or store force: a locked thing keeps its own speed, and anything standing still is out of reach.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as reading every moving thing at once floods your eyes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Dodging +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Frozen Swing, Turnabout Throw
Vector Lock Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user locks a moving thing's motion so it hangs a moment, then releases it on its old line or a new one, same speed. New adult user, by touch: a punch, swung weapon, thrown object or lunging person, up to motorbike weight at city-street car speed, for a heartbeat or two. Glance, easing and multiple locks need techniques. Limits: motion only (nothing still, parked or a wall); never adds speed or stores force. A locked person still breathes, sees and speaks. Over truck weight or highway speed slides through; unseen, unfelt attacks land. Quirk Strain: light: locking or turning one blow or throw; moderate: glance-locking a runner, midair pivot, easing a fall; heavy: turning gunfire or several chargers; severe: signature stillness, rerouting a block. Type: Emitter. Law: locking a person is use of force; anything turned into a bystander is the user's own Quirk use. Look: pinpoint pupils; locked things stop with a dull thump, dust hanging still.
